# Error analysis tables (generated by `make analysis`)

Out-of-fold predictions on the training split (24,000 clients), threshold 0.16. Costs are per client, in units of one false alarm; a missed defaulter costs 5. Recall = share of defaulters flagged; false positive rate = share of non-defaulters flagged.

## Threshold stability

- Cost-optimal threshold within each of the 5 folds: 0.16, 0.20, 0.16, 0.16, 0.20
- Thresholds within 2% of the minimum cost: 0.15–0.20; within 5%: 0.12–0.24

## Fairness audit: young clients and credit limits

False positive rate of good clients aged 21–25: 49.6%. Reweighted to the credit-limit quintile mix of good clients aged 26–40: 30.4%. Median credit limit: NT$50,000 (21–25) vs NT$160,000 (26–40).

## Missed defaulters

1,237 of 5,309 defaulters were not flagged. 90.6% of them had no positive repayment status in the last 6 months (vs 34.5% of all defaulters).
